import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Standardize species labels to title case (matches allowed values)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (handles possible text numbers)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas, handle text numbers)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute mean body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
